name: Grain
description: AI meeting recording and notes platform; public v2 API exposes recordings, transcripts, highlights, stories, uploads and event hooks.
access_notes: Personal Access Tokens are self-generated at grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api but require a paid Starter plan or above (Free plan has no API access). Workspace Access Tokens need Business/Enterprise plus an admin. OAuth2 client_id/client_secret are 'obtained separately', i.e. not fully self-serve.
mcp_notes: No official Grain MCP server found in vendor docs (developers.grain.com, support.grain.com) or via web search; no Composio toolkit (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/grain returns 404).
uncertainty_notes: OAuth2 client registration process is not documented as self-serve ('Obtain the client_id and client_secret... separately'), and an older aggregator note described the public API beta as limited to select partners; the current official support article contradicts that for PATs, which are plan-gated but self-serve. Every v2 request also requires a Public-Api-Version header.

evidence.note: PATs generated at grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api; standard OAuth2 authorization-code flow with PKCE; Authorization: Bearer TOKEN; Hooks API (POST /_/public-api/v2/hooks/create) with recording/highlight/story/upload events

'Personal API access is available on Starter, Business, and Enterprise plans... The Free plan does not include API access'; WAT requires Business/Enterprise admin; API reads meeting data, manages recordings, real-time events
